manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: A ball is tossed upward beside its velocity-time graph. At the top the velocity is zero but the slope, the acceleration, stays -g.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.description: Left, a ball on a height ruler with velocity and acceleration arrows. Right, the velocity-time line with a marker and slope segment. Readouts show velocity, acceleration, gravitational force and motion state.
